meta.title: Features — Mataresit
meta.description: Line-item extraction, smart search, Malaysian SST intelligence, batch upload, team review, claims and analytics — the capabilities behind a clean receipt ledger.

hero.lede: Mataresit takes the photo, the email or the folder of scans and returns line items, SST, merchant and category — with a confidence score on every field and a review trail behind it.

extractionCard.label: Receipt 04 · extraction
extractionCard.foot: Every field stays editable before it enters the ledger.

extraction.title: Line items, not just a total.
extraction.lede: Most tools read the merchant and the grand total. Mataresit reads what the money was actually spent on: every line, the tax line and the payment, then scores its own confidence so the uncertain fields stand out.
checks: Merchant, date, line items, tax and payment extracted
Confidence scoring on every field, not just the header
Anything below the line goes to review instead of the ledger

search.title: One field that knows where things are.
search.lede: Search a merchant, an item, a category, a payment method or an amount. Mataresit looks across the receipt and its line items, so “nasi lemak” finds the receipt even when the merchant name never mentions it.
checks: Search merchants, items, categories, payments and amounts
Filter by status, month and category without losing the query
Results keep the line item that matched, not just the merchant

malaysia.title: Built around how Malaysian receipts are printed.
malaysia.lede: Kopitiam names, SST lines, day-first dates, ringgit and the occasional foreign-currency card slip. The extraction model is tuned for the receipts your team actually comes back with.
checks: SST captured as its own line, not folded into the total
Local merchant names, addresses and day-first dates recognised
Multi-currency detection when the card slip and receipt disagree

mock.label: SST breakdown
mock.footLeft: Read from a Kuala Lumpur kopitiam receipt

batch.title: A month of receipts, not a month of typing.
batch.lede: Drop a batch of files and let the queue work through them. Each file carries its own status, and anything the model is unsure about lands in review instead of the ledger.
checks: Batch uploads of 5, 50 or 100 files depending on plan
Per-file progress, so a slow scan never blocks the rest
Uncertain receipts routed to review, not quietly approved

team.title: One receipt, one visible trail.
team.lede: Invite the team, share a receipt, and let role-based permissions decide who can approve. Claims move through the same workspace, so the approved receipt and its claim never drift apart.
checks: Team invitations and shared receipt access
Claims management beside the receipt that started it

reporting.title: Numbers that survive the month-end.
reporting.lede: Spend by category, merchant analysis, monthly and quarterly trends — and on Max, year-over-year comparisons and tax deduction identification. Export the ledger as CSV whenever finance asks.

mock.label: October spend
mock.chartLabel: October spend by category: Meals RM 412.30, Travel RM 289.00, Office RM 154.20.

platform.title: Also in the box.
platform.lede: The smaller pieces that keep a receipt workspace usable on a Tuesday afternoon, not just in a launch post.

items.title: Custom categories
items.description: Build the chart of accounts your finance team already uses, then let receipts fall into it.

items.title: Secure storage
items.description: Receipts and line items live with your workspace, not in a shared drive or somebody’s inbox.

items.title: Real-time notifications
items.description: Know when a receipt lands, a batch finishes, or a field needs a second look.

items.title: Mobile & PWA
items.description: Install Mataresit to the home screen and capture from the queue, not from a laptop bag.

items.title: API access
items.description: Push receipts in and pull structured data out, on Max, without exporting a spreadsheet first.

items.title: Subscription management
items.description: Change plan or billing period from the workspace, without an email thread.

items.title: Help centre
items.description: Guides for setup, search, claims and exports — written for the person doing the filing.

items.title: Export options
items.description: Take the ledger with you as CSV, including the line items and the tax you captured.

plans.title: Same read. Three sizes.
plans.lede: Every plan includes line-item extraction, confidence scoring, multi-currency detection and CSV export. The difference is volume, team tools and how deep the reporting goes.

cta.title: The month closes itself.
cta.lede: Drop the month’s receipts, review what’s uncertain, and close the books with a trail behind every number.
